analyticalQuestion: What one-variable object is canonically selected by the edge grading, and do exact finite D-log Pade approximants show a stable candidate obstruction beyond the proved fixed-charge convergence disc?
supportedClaim: For fixed charge q, the coefficient series F_q(R)=[Xi^q]F(R,Xi) is analytic for |R|<(4/81)^3 by the R0.31 all-order layer bound. For q=1, exact coefficients through endpoint parameter 50 give 22 U/V diagonal D-log Pade approximants whose unique simple real poles lie in the all-cut hull [-0.749701196287094659168546,-0.749433079639935448247912]; the cut-42-through-50 hull has width below 10^-4, and every transport residue is below -1/2. These are certified properties of finite rational approximants, not singularities of the original series. The closer D-center feature near -0.723449 has residue near +1 and is classified as a zero candidate.

simulation.configuration: exact edge recurrence through total degree 149; charge-one endpoints through parameter 50; even coefficient cuts 30 through 50; diagonal D-log Pade approximants; exact real-root isolation and exact residue enclosures; independent 160-bit and 256-bit numerical checks
simulation.precision: GMP exact rational coefficients and SymPy exact polynomial isolation; 160-bit and 256-bit numerical cross-checks
simulation.solver: deterministic scalar formal-series recurrence, exact Pade linear systems, Sturm-based real-root isolation, and interval evaluation

tolerances.rootIsolation: exact rational intervals and Sturm counts
tolerances.candidateCluster: reported as the hull of exact isolating intervals, not a fitted confidence interval
tolerances.crossPrecision: independent 160-bit and 256-bit numerical agreement checked by the audit

Exact guaranteed fixed-charge radius and exact rational hulls for all transport cuts, tail transport cuts, and D-center zero candidates.

caption.chineseSiteSummary: 固定荷 q=1 的 U/V 对角 D-log Pade 极点在连续截断下聚集于约 -0.7495，留数为负；D 中更近的约 -0.723449 特征留数接近 +1，因此先判为零点候选。所有结论仅属于有限有理逼近。
